requirement: 종결된 prompt-refiner-shadow-evidence-gate-v1 exchange의 round 2에 남은 재현 가능한 두 finding을 수정한다. unknown-only case shortfall은 case_evidence_incomplete로, 실제 case failure는 case_evidence_failed로 분리하고 혼합 상태를 회귀 테스트한다. evidence spec duplicate-key 검사는 실제 duplicate parser branch를 실행함을 직접 증명한다. 기존 provider-independent content-free 경계, frozen corpus 결속, authority false 값과 비용·UI·Router 비승인 상태는 유지한다. author는 Codex, reviewer는 Claude Code Max이며 사용자 승인 --skip-preflight 예외 아래 Read/Grep/Glob only로 검토한다.

기존 evidence core 집중 테스트, 전체 unit, TypeScript, 수정 파일 ESLint, 문서·정책 절 참조, diff whitespace 검사가 통과한다.
Claude verdict는 새 package digest에 결속하고 actionable finding마다 location, severity, evidence와 reproduction을 기록한다.
provider 호출, Railway 변경, stage/run 승인, 유료 실행, 제품 UI, Router 결합 또는 rollout 권한을 추가하지 않는다.

findings.claim: The requirement asks for a regression test of the mixed state, but the suite only covers failed-only (:231-240, asserts case_evidence_failed and not case_evidence_incomplete) and unknown-only (:250-260, the inverse); no test evaluates a run containing both a `fail` case and an `insufficient_evidence` case, so the branch combination at lib/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.ts:823-828 that emits both reasons together is never exercised.
findings.reproduction: grep -n "case_evidence" tests/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.test.mjs returns only lines 234, 236, 253, 255 — two single-status scenarios. Expected: an additional scenario, e.g. `const mixed = passingRunCases(); mixed[0] = {caseId: mixed[0].caseId, terminalStatus: "failed", refinedPrompt: null, durationMs: 800, costMicroUsd: null}; mixed[1] = {caseId: mixed[1].caseId, terminalStatus: "unknown", refinedPrompt: null, durationMs: null, costMicroUsd: null};` whose bundle asserts gateReasons includes both `case_evidence_failed` and `case_evidence_incomplete` and gateOutcome is `fail`. Run `node --conditions=react-server --import tsx --test tests/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.test.mjs` to confirm it passes once added (the implementation already behaves this way; only the coverage is absent).

findings.claim: The `failedEvidenceCases === 0 && incompleteEvidenceCases === 0` fallback is unreachable, because evidenceStatus is one of pass/fail/insufficient_evidence, cases.length is pinned to 16 by the `run_requires_16_cases` check, and the digest-bound spec sets requiredCasePasses to 16 — so zero fails and zero incompletes implies passedCases === 16 and the outer `if` at :822 is never entered.
findings.reproduction: Inspection only (no runtime repro available under Read/Grep/Glob): docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow/evidence-spec-v1.json:10 pins requiredCasePasses to 16, tests/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.test.mjs:310-311 shows a 15-row run throws before reaching the gate, and lib/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.ts:584-585 shows the only three evidenceStatus values. The existing injection fallback at :840-842 is unreachable for the same reason, so keeping the symmetry is defensible; recorded so the dead branch is not mistaken for tested behaviour.

rounds.nextAction: Add the mixed failed+unknown regression assertion to tests/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.test.mjs and resubmit; both superseded v1 findings are otherwise correctly closed (unknown-only now yields case_evidence_incomplete alone, and the new fixture is valid JSON with a duplicate `purpose` key that makes parseBenchmarkJson throw json_duplicate_key directly while parsePromptRefinerShadowEvidenceSpec wraps it as spec_json_invalid).

inheritedFindings.claim: The round-1 missing/failed naming split was applied to the injection reasons (:818-828) but not to the general counter, so a run whose only shortfall is an unknown terminal still reports the gate reason `case_evidence_failed` while no case has evidenceStatus `fail` and the outcome is `insufficient_evidence`.
inheritedFindings.reproduction: Run tests/promptRefinerShadowEvidenceCore.test.mjs's "terminal failures fail while unknown or incomplete telemetry is insufficient" case and inspect `unknownBundle`: with row 0 set to terminalStatus "unknown" (refinedPrompt/durationMs/costMicroUsd all null), gateOutcome is "insufficient_evidence" and every case evidenceStatus is "pass" or "insufficient_evidence", yet gateReasons contains "case_evidence_failed" alongside "unknown_present"/"cost_incomplete"/"latency_incomplete". A reason named `case_evidence_incomplete` for the unknown-only shortfall would match the injection split.

inheritedFindings.claim: The assertion that docs/ops/prompt-refiner-shadow-evidence-gate-v1.md:135 lists as duplicate-key coverage feeds syntactically invalid JSON rather than a duplicate key, so duplicate-key rejection of the spec document is never exercised.
inheritedFindings.reproduction:
specText.replace('"schemaVersion"', '"schemaVersion"
, "schemaVersion"') yields `{
  "schemaVersion"
, "schemaVersion": "prompt-refiner-shadow-evidence-spec-v1",` — parseBenchmarkJson (lib/routerDevelopmentBenchmark.ts:113-114) hits `text[position++] !== ":"` and throws json_syntax, never reaching the json_duplicate_key branch at :111; the catch-all in parsePromptRefinerShadowEvidenceSpec maps both to spec_json_invalid, so the regex passes either way. A true duplicate (e.g. inserting a second `"purpose": "development-only",` line) is what exercises :111.
